name: Printroll
summary: Recovery codes that print on a paper roll, with copy, download, tear-off and a one-code check
about: A little thermal printer feeds a receipt of ten recovery codes up out of its slot, line by line, in peach, charcoal and mint. Copy them all, download them as a text file, or tear the sheet off to print a fresh set that cancels the old one. Then tick that you saved them and type any one code back; it gets a pink marker stripe on the sheet and recovery turns on with confetti.
how: Watch the codes print, then press Copy all or Download to keep them
Press New codes on the printer to tear off the sheet and print a new set
Tick I saved these codes somewhere safe and press Continue
Type or paste any one code from the sheet; backspace and the arrow keys move between boxes
A matching code is marked on the sheet and recovery is turned on
